content.short: Damn Vulnerable DeFi is a wargame that teaches offensive security of DeFi smart contracts.
content.description: Damn Vulnerable DeFi is an educational platform that teaches offensive security for DeFi smart contracts through an interactive wargame. Challenges simulate real-world attack and defense scenarios, asking players to disrupt a protocol or steal funds, then analyze and remediate the weaknesses. Through these games, participants develop practical skills for bug hunting and security auditing in the DeFi space, gaining hands-on insight into securing decentralized finance systems and improving protocol resilience.
content.meta: Damn Vulnerable DeFi teaches offensive DeFi security via a wargame. Discover Damn Vulnerable DeFi and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
